title: Decide whether a Network's central admins may open the owner's billing, and make the code and SCAN-983 say the same

source.ref: Scan nine (2026-10-19 weekly meta scan), docs/META-SCAN-STATUS.md

detail: SCAN-983 (#3502) says central admins are real admins of the Network parent but 'never isOwner, so billing stays the owner's'. The Space billing actions gate on caps.isAdmin only, so a central admin can open the owner's Stripe billing portal (cancel, change card), change operator seats (a prorated charge) and start a loadout checkout. The ADRs say Space admins manage billing, so this follows the existing design; the false promise is the problem. Ruling: gate openSpaceBillingPortal, setOperatorSeats and startSpaceLoadoutCheckout on caps.isOwner, or correct SCAN-983 and the help text.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/billing/actions.ts','utf8');if(!/isOwner/.test(s)){console.error('SCAN-1009: the Space billing actions admit any admin, including a Network central admin');process.exit(1)}"
